evidence: Adrian Sherwood is credited as producer on African Head Charge's debut album 'My Life in a Hole in the Ground' (1981), On-U Sound's first release, and on the group's subsequent records.

earlier.title: My Life in a Hole in the Ground

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Both records layer African and Caribbean percussion under heavy dub echo and dropout, Sherwood's signature technique. The later record is denser and more processed, five years of the same partnership deepening.

explanation: Sherwood produced African Head Charge's first album, which was also On-U Sound's first release, layering dub production techniques under Bonjo Iyabinghi Noah's percussion. It is a founding production relationship, and it shows the label's first way of working in miniature.
